definitions.Administrator: the Deputy of Securities appointed pursuant to NRS 225.060 (NRS 90.215)
definitions.Division: the Securities Division of the Office of the Secretary of State (NRS 90.230)

sections.heading: Licensing of broker-dealers, sales representatives and transfer agents.
Licensing of investment advisers and representatives of investment advisers.
Investment advisers to certain private funds exempt from licensing.

readings.licensing_term: NRS 90.310 and 90.330 say 'licensed'; the IAPD STATE feed records the same credential as StateRgstn with status APPROVED. The page quotes both and does not convert either into an endorsement.
readings.iar_is_person: NRS 90.330 licenses investment advisers and representatives of investment advisers separately.
readings.bd_and_sales_rep: NRS 90.310 licenses broker-dealers and sales representatives; transfer agents are a separate class in the same section.
readings.private_fund_exemption: NRS 90.345 exempts certain private-fund advisers from licensing; ERA reporting is not licensing.
readings.enforcement_powers: NRS 90.620 (investigations and subpoenas) and NRS 90.630 (enforcement orders) are the Administrator's powers. A power is not an acquired action.
